"""Full current checks against the already completed identical pristine baseline."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import difflib
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
import re

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata')
W = G / '.worktree/feat-phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013'
C = G / '.worktree/diag-native-copy-queue-qualified-20261013'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase_full_lint_final_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'


def load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def dump(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')


def findings(value, root):
    result = []
    for line in value.splitlines():
        line = line.replace(str(root) + '/', '')
        match = re.match(r'(.+?):(\d+)(?::\d+|,\d+)?: (warning|error): (.+)', line)
        if match:
            path, number, severity, message = match.groups()
            result.append((path, int(number), severity, message))
            continue
        match = re.match(r'(CMakeLists\.txt):(\d+)(?:,\d+)?: (\[C\d+\].+)', line)
        if match:
            path, number, message = match.groups()
            result.append((path, int(number), 'cmake', message))
            continue
        match = re.match(r'(.+?):(\d+): (.+ ==> .+)', line)
        if match:
            path, number, message = match.groups()
            result.append((path, int(number), 'codespell', message))
    return result


def key(row):
    path, number, severity, message = row
    # Same class and unchanged padding byte counts are an existing finding.
    # Keep full original messages; only the suggested field-order tail varies.
    if '[clang-analyzer-optin.performance.Padding]' in message:
        message = message.split('Optimal fields order:')[0] + '[clang-analyzer-optin.performance.Padding]'
    return path, number, severity, message


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    build_path = B / 'main-phase-cache-serial-gate-build-root-v6/record.json'
    baseline_path = B / 'main-phase-cache-full-lints-root-v2/record.json'
    build, baseline_record = load(build_path), load(baseline_path)
    assert build['passed'] and build['complete'] and not build['active']
    original_full_lint_path = B / 'main-phase-cache-full-lints-root-v3/record.json'
    original_full_lint = load(original_full_lint_path)
    publication_path = B / 'main-phase-cache-admission-publication-root-v1/record.json'
    publication = load(publication_path)
    assert original_full_lint['passed'] and original_full_lint['lints_qualified'] and not original_full_lint['active']
    assert publication['passed'] and publication['complete'] and not publication['active']
    assert publication['commit'] == '54385d6f975a13df5da87f489614d0b729d2aba6'
    assert build['compiler_affected_files'] == ['src/program/generate.cpp']
    assert all(m.sha(W / name) == digest for name, digest in original_full_lint['source_pins'].items()
               if name != 'src/program/generate.cpp' and not name.startswith('docs/'))
    assert not baseline_record['active'] and not baseline_record['passed']
    baseline_command = next(c for c in baseline_record['commands'] if c['label'] == 'baseline-full-source-lints')
    assert m.closed(baseline_command) and baseline_command['session_anchored'] and baseline_command['exit_code'] == 1
    out = B / 'main-phase-cache-serial-gate-lints-root-v4'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    env = dict(baseline_record['environment'])
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True, commands=[], evidence={},
             environment=env, source_pins=build['source_pins'], lints_qualified=False, gpu_executed=False,
             no_checks_disabled=True, baseline_receipt_sha256=m.sha(baseline_path),
             build_receipt_sha256=m.sha(build_path), retained_original_failed_status=True)

    def save():
        dump(out / 'record.json', r)

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, cwd=W, allowed=(0,)):
        print('OWNED SOURCE CHECK ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, cwd, wall=900, cpu=7200, rss_cap=6 << 30,
                            text_cap=8 << 20, total_cap=32 << 20)
        stdout, stderr = so.read_text(), se.read_text()
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        assert 'skipped (' not in stdout + stderr
        return stdout + '\n' + stderr

    try:
        assert run('baseline-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], C).strip() == '410904c99d273435b5302fa8976cc667d17957f2'
        assert not run('baseline-tracked-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no'], C).strip()
        assert run('candidate-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).strip() == publication['commit']
        assert run('candidate-change-scope', ['git', 'diff', '--name-only']).strip() == 'src/program/generate.cpp'
        r['inherited_full_lint'] = dict(path=str(original_full_lint_path), sha256=m.sha(original_full_lint_path))
        r['inherited_doc_lints'] = dict(path=str(publication_path), sha256=m.sha(publication_path))
        r['actual_affected_lint_files'] = ['src/program/generate.cpp']
        save()
        old_text = {name: (C / name).read_text() for name in build['source_pins'] if (C / name).is_file()}
        current_text = {name: (W / name).read_text() for name in build['source_pins']}
        assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in build['source_pins'].items())
        expected_before = [str(C / 'build/free') if arg == str(W / 'build/free') else arg
                           for arg in baseline_command['argv']]
        assert expected_before[0:2] == ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh']
        assert expected_before[2:] == list(old_text)
        source_env = {k: v for k, v in env.items() if k != 'STRATA_LINT_BUILD'}
        assert source_env == {k: v for k, v in baseline_command['environment'].items() if k != 'STRATA_LINT_BUILD'}
        before_output = baseline_record['evidence']['baseline-full-source-lints']
        before = findings(before_output['stdout'] + '\n' + before_output['stderr'], C)
        mappings = {}
        for name in old_text.keys() & current_text.keys():
            blocks = difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=old_text[name].splitlines(), b=current_text[name].splitlines(), autojunk=False).get_matching_blocks()
            mappings[name] = {block.a + i + 1: block.b + i + 1 for block in blocks for i in range(block.size)}
        allowed = Counter()
        for path, line, severity, message in before:
            mapped = mappings[path].get(line) if path in mappings else line
            if mapped is not None:
                allowed[key((path, mapped, severity, message))] += 1
        after_output = run('candidate-generate-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', 'src/program/generate.cpp'], allowed=(0, 1))
        after = findings(after_output, W)
        r['novel_findings'] = []
        for row in after:
            if allowed[key(row)]:
                allowed[key(row)] -= 1
            else:
                r['novel_findings'].append(row)
        r['baseline_findings'] = before
        r['candidate_findings'] = after
        r['padding_comparison_policy'] = 'Exact class/checker/severity/location and identical padding byte counts; full original field-order suggestions retained'
        save()
        assert not r['novel_findings'], 'Inspect remaining new findings; no suppression allowed'
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check'])
        assert all((C / name).read_text() == text for name, text in old_text.items())
        assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in build['source_pins'].items())
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, lints_qualified=True,
                 scope='Changed generator checks against actual immutable pristine baseline; all unchanged source checks and publication-only docs inherit their completed full checks; no checks disabled')
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'lints_qualified', 'novel_findings')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
